family_principle: Every selectable or invalidating research identity is registered before outcomes. Shared heads and mandatory seed replications are not independently selectable hypotheses, but their all-required failures remain terminal evidence.

ordered_ledger.canonical_JSON: UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, no NaN or Infinity

frozen_nonselectable_matched_random_algo.attempt_random_key: SHA-256 UTF-8 canonical tuple(base_seed_hex,attempt_id,outer_fold,session,decision_time_ns,source_neutral_contract_id,expiry_yyyymmdd,strike_milli_points,right_code); first unsigned 64 big-endian bits rank, full digest breaks ties
pre_outcome_construction: Freeze candidate artifact hash, universal grid hash, causal action trace, and intent counts before reading any future path or PnL outcome.
Derive exact intent budgets by session, call/put, ATM/NEAR/WING, and decision-time premium band.
Within each cell rank every causally legal minute-contract pair by attempt_random_key and take the required count without replacement.
If a cell cannot supply its exact budget, mark that registered attempt incomplete; never borrow from another cell.
Generate all eight attempts exactly once.
frozen_nonselectable_matched_random_algo.serial_replay: Each complete schedule traverses its own FT2-10 t+1 fills, occupancy, D48, D49, soft-close, daily-stop, neutral lifecycle, and separate $3/$4 ledgers.
frozen_nonselectable_matched_random_algo.validity: All eight registered attempts must be complete and pass every pre-outcome and post-replay rule.
frozen_nonselectable_matched_random_algo.aggregate: When and only when all eight attempts are valid, report every individual schedule and the frozen equal-weight mean of their session statistics.

strong_shuffle_family.significant_positive_increment_rule: If a strong shuffled model has both adjusted one-sided p<=0.05 and adjusted 95% lower bound>0 over a valid matched-random control, route invalid_evidence for real-candidate selection.

required_real_candidate_contrasts_per_li: candidate versus each of eight matched-random schedules
candidate versus the equal-weight matched-random aggregate
MNAR no-bid primary versus sensitivity ranking identity

required_comparators: best fixed or transparent exit on identical entries

required_dollar_contrasts: complete combined system minus candidate-specific exposure-matched random aggregate

admitted_channel_combinations.rule: Every owner-admitted active-channel set and every channel combination that can be separately selected, shortlisted, stopped, frozen, or promoted has a distinct pre-outcome family identity.
admitted_channel_combinations.family_size: Computed exactly from the preregistered channel-set manifest before outcomes; UNKNOWN is not a valid evidence packet.

family_counting.why: The old count omitted alpha=0.0, matched-random attempts and aggregate, shuffled contrasts, action-gate metrics, and admitted-channel combinations.
count_includes: all selectable lineages and composer variants
all selectable admitted-channel sets and invalidating ablations
all failed, incomplete, and abandoned registered identities
all hard calibration and no-harm statistics
count_excludes_only: shared jointly trained forecast heads that cannot be selected separately
pure diagnostics that cannot select, reject, freeze, promote, reset a plateau, or change a terminal

control_validity_and_plateau.plateau_reset_rule: Only a preregistered serious trial that has valid controls and earns the already-frozen stage success terminal may reset the plateau. Diagnostic improvement, control mismatch, missing evidence, or an owner tripwire cannot reset it.
